searchText: 3074 will provide an alternative option for the WISP pattern. Rich Transactions would as well. Also, the wisp pattern is crazy expensive, no? `200 * len(code)` gas for the code (that portion does not get refunded) _and you have to pay for that per transaction_ Oh also EIP 3403 is making wisp much less viable already
